apps.name: Controller-9
apps.subtitle: Your phone is the controller
apps.localizedDescription: Turn your iPhone into a game controller for your computer: five familiar layouts, grip-relative tilt steering and rumble, over your own Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. No account, no cloud. Needs the free Controller-9 companion on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer.

versions.localizedDescription: Pairing falls back to Bluetooth when the Wi-Fi keeps devices apart; customised layouts drawn in black glass; the in-game bar fits between the triggers.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connect to your computer over Bluetooth when Wi-Fi is off or unavailable.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown on your computer.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Find and connect to Controller-9 on computers on your Wi-Fi network.
